annotations.text:
DIRECTION A - Dark front, light back.
Matches the brochure. Looks premium in hand. Ask the printer for MATTE lamination - a glossy dark card shows every fingerprint.

DIRECTION B - Light front, dark back.
Safer, cheaper to print, easier to write on. The blue edge bar keeps it from looking plain.
TO FILL IN: office address + GSTIN on the A-Back card. Also confirm the name - the brochure says "Vijay Kumar".
